page_title: UNI 2-1 WER | Union Berlin v Werder Bremen 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
90+3' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+2' Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Schlager stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Naby Keita (Werder Bremen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' Werder Bremen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
88' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' A substitution has been made. Julian Malatini goes off and Naby Keita (Werder Bremen) comes on.
85' It will be a substitution. Alex Kral (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Tousart walks off.
85' Nenad Bjelica has decided to make a change. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) replaces Robin Gosens.
84' A cross from Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
82' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) sprays a pass out to Benedict Hollerbach, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
79' Werder Bremen will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) is replacing Brenden Aaronson.
77' The attendance is 22012.
76' Here is a change. Jens Stage is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).
76' Here comes a substitution. Justin Njinmah is given a rest as he is replaced by Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
74' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
72' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is cautioned by the referee.
70' The Union Berlin players can’t believe it after referee Daniel Schlager signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
70' Referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
68' Surely that's handball by one of the Werder Bremen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
68' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' It is time for a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is on for Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen.
68' Nenad Bjelica decides to make a substitution. Yorbe Vertessen will be replaced by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin).
66' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
65' The ball is cleared after Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Olivier Deman is replaced by Felix Agu (Werder Bremen).
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) coming on for Senne Lynen.

63' 2 - 1 Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) outjumps the defenders inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a header into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:1.
63' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is about to take a corner kick.

62' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
60' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Schlager had a clear view and blows his whistle.

55' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Frederik Ronnow makes a comfortable save.

52' 2 - 0 Goal! Yorbe Vertessen displays great vision and sends a pass to Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 2:0.

50' 1 - 0 Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) is the first to get to a rebound and his weak but precise effort finds its way through the defenders in the goalmouth and into the back of the net, bouncing in off the left post.
49' The corner by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
46' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will take the corner.
45+2' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Michael Zetterer thwarts him with a nice save.
45+1' The resulting corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
41' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
38' Yellow card. Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
36' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
33' The referee Daniel Schlager awards Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) a yellow card.
32' An attempted cross from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared.
30' What was Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
30' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Lucas Tousart. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
27' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
26' Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
26' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
24' Michael Zetterer leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin).
24' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
20' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
19' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' The resulting corner, taken by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), comes to nothing.
18' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
15' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) and Robin Gosens matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
12' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michael Zetterer, who smothers the ball.
9' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) commits a foul and Daniel Schlager immediately signals a free kick.
6' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' Union Berlin hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
3' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
